verdict.rationale: Apify publishes Docker base images that developers can freely use and that Apify runs on its own platform (apify-docs-30). Actors are its way of packaging code for deployment (apify-docs-13), and existing projects can be moved onto the platform (apify-docs-11), so containerized Actors can be deployed for production on Apify. The evidence does not show a documented path for running the scraping service as a Docker container in your own production infrastructure, and the Dockerfile and deploy workflow is only implied. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted Docker production deployment, Dockerfile/build-and-push workflow details, independent hands-on corroboration.
